rules.materialModifiers: Average gold_drops and entity-type drops independently with integer truncation; apply their sum additively, minimum 0.5 * base, then roll the fractional remainder. Existing cooperative base-value scaling is a separate parity dependency.
rules.harvesting: Non-positive does not grow. Normal waves ceil(current * (5 + additive harvesting_growth) / 100). Beyond 20 waves remove ceil(current * 20 / 100). Apply ordinary stat gain modifiers.
rules.recycling: floor(price * clamp(0.25 + recycling_gains / 100, 0.01, 1)), minimum 1, capped by shop price. Price-stat affects recycle basis through wave 20, shop-price cap still uses it in endless.
rules.walletStart: Apply gain_pct_gold_start_wave at the real wave start, before retry checkpoint. Negative applies in all waves and becomes -100 in endless; positive only through wave 20.
